map.月用电 600 kWh、30 天：日均 20 kWh、若均匀日用 20/24≈0: Monthly use 600 kWh, 30 days: daily average 20 kWh; if used uniformly across the day, 20/24≈0.83 kW average power; but with an air conditioner the peak can reach 3-5 kW, so choose the breaker/incoming line by the peak, not the average. Tip: average for energy, peak for capacity.
map.平均功率能选空开吗？: Can the average power be used to choose a breaker?
map.不能。空开按峰值电流选型，平均功率只反映能耗，二者不可混用。: No. The breaker is selected by the peak current; average power only reflects energy consumption and the two cannot be mixed.
map.为什么电量高但空开不大？: Why is the electricity high but the breaker small?
map.若负荷分散在全天（如冰箱）峰值低，空开小；若短时大负载（即热热水器）峰值高需大空: If the load is spread across the day (e.g., a fridge) the peak is low and the breaker is small; if there is a short high load (e.g., an instant water heater) the peak is high and a large breaker is needed.
